marks.gloss_en: ומנלן? דכתיב: ונצומה ונבקשה מאלהינו על זאת -- מכלל דאיכא אחריתי
במערבא אמרי משמיה דרבי חגי מהכא: על רזא דנה -- מכלל דאיכא אחריתי
one does not pray for two [troubles at once]
מנא לך הא? דכתיב: כי מן היום הראשון אשר נתת את לבך... ולהתענות... נשמעו דבריך
whence do you have this? 'fear not, Daniel, for from the first day that you set your heart to understand and to fast before your God, your words were heard' (Dan 10:12)
היינו דאמר רבה בר שילא: קשה יומא דמיטרא כיומא דדינא
R' Yitzchak: even in years like Elijah's, if rain falls on Friday eves it is only a sign of curse
Bar Kappara: 'closing' is said of rain and of a woman (Gen 20:18; Deut 11:17)
'birth' is said of a woman and of rain (Gen 30:23 etc.; Isa 55:10)
'remembering' is said of a woman and of rain (Gen 21:1; Ps 65:10)
what is 'the channel of God full of water' (Ps 65:10)? it was taught: there is a kind of dome in the sky from which rain comes out
R' Shmuel bar Nachmani (Job 37:13): 'whether for a rod' -- on mountains and hills; 'whether for kindness He finds it for His land' -- on fields and vineyards
[or:] 'for a rod' -- for trees; 'for His land' -- for seeds; 'for kindness' -- pits, ditches and caves
the people, in famine and plague: to pray for both is impossible; rather let us pray for the plague and bear the famine
R' Zeira, when a persecution forbade fasting: let us accept [the fast] upon ourselves, and when the persecution is annulled we will sit it
R' Yitzchak: sun on Shabbat is charity for the poor (Mal 3:20)
R' Yitzchak: blessing is found only in a thing hidden from the eye -- 'the Lord will command the blessing upon you in your barns (asamecha)' (Deut 28:8)
one who enters to measure his granary says: 'may it be Your will, Lord our God, that You send blessing on the work of our hands'
R' Yochanan: the day of rain is great, for even armies cease on it
R' Yochanan: the day of rain is as great as the day of the ingathering of the exiles
